coverage: JEE Main 2014 Paper 1 final answer key for the 6 April offline Sets E-H and the 9, 11, 12 and 19 April online examinations.
verification: The PDF was preserved from the original official jeemain.nic.in host on 13 May 2014. Its official filename is 'FINAL JEE14 KEY.pdf'. All eight pages were downloaded, hashed, text-extracted and visually rendered. Each page is headed 'JEE(Main) - 2014 Final Key' and maps one-to-one to the eight official Paper 1 question papers already catalogued: offline Sets E-H followed by the 9, 11, 12 and 19 April online examinations.
exclusions: The earlier consolidated answerkey.pdf, Paper 2 KEY2.pdf, candidate response/OMR records, question papers and third-party worked solutions are excluded.
hostingPolicy: Link-only. The PDF is linked through a preserved Internet Archive capture of the original official jeemain.nic.in host and is not mirrored by JEENEETARD.
